dataset: Spider development SQL execution/repair request replay
semantics: Fixed causal SQL request replay. Ouro-2.6B greedy teacher, actual read-only SQLite execution, at most two error-triggered repairs. No gold SQL feedback. Successful execution ends a trace. Current teacher response, tool result and future calls removed from replay inputs. No live-agent or official Spider accuracy claim. Distinct from the unpublished SuffixDecoding AgenticSQL dataset.
timing: Decode-only; prefill, warmup, loading and journal I/O excluded. Includes suffix publication.
limitations: Fixed historical SQL requests, not closed-loop task performance. B1 token/s is not concurrent serving throughput. Output lengths can differ.
